Capability adapter — claude-code [supported]
  support levels: discoverable supported, selectable supported, invocable supported, enforceable supported
  bootstrap: sessionstart-hook
  acquisition: read Read, search Grep+Glob [supported]
  storage: consumer project <cwd>/tasks/active (cwd-keyed; not plugin-owned)
  gating events: pre_tool, stop
  ⚠ security/privacy enforcement gaps (1):
      prompt_submitted: prompt_submitted fires but cannot guarantee a block (UserPromptSubmit block is a documented host capability, but no shipped hook blocks there (handlers are inject-only) — no in-repo proof)

  Invocation shapes
    invoke-skill     supported    Skill tool (by skill name)
    invoke-agent     supported    Agent/Task tool (by agent type)
    invoke-command   supported    slash command
    invoke-workflow  advisory     entry skill/command composition
    lifecycle-hook   supported    hook registered in settings.json
    none             unsupported  (not directly invocable)

  Workflow operations
    ask_user         supported    AskUserQuestion tool
    manage_plan      supported    TaskCreate / TaskUpdate / TaskList tools, plus plan files under tasks/plans/
    run_shell        supported    Bash tool
    delegate_agent   supported    Agent/Task tool (by agent type)

  Lifecycle events
    session_start      supported — SessionStart hook in shipped settings.json (observe/inject)
    pre_tool           supported [gate] — PreToolUse hook denies a tool call via exit 2 / permissionDecision:deny
    post_tool          supported — PostToolUse hook in shipped settings.json (observe)
    tool_failure       supported — PostToolUseFailure hook in shipped settings.json (observe)
    prompt_submitted   supported — UserPromptSubmit block is a documented host capability, but no shipped hook blocks there (handlers are inject-only) — no in-repo proof
    stop               supported [gate] — Stop hook can block the stop (pre-completion-check security-BLOCK, exit 2)
    pre_compaction     supported — PreCompact hook in shipped settings.json (observe)
    subagent_start     supported — Host capability, documented in the Claude Code hooks reference (retrieved 2026-11-09): fires once per subagent spawn/resume, cannot block, context-injection only. This kit registers NO handler — settings.json's SubagentStart array is deliberately empty — so there is no in-repo proof and none is claimed
    subagent_stop      supported — SubagentStop hook in shipped settings.json (observe)
